name: Dawn-Eternal
description: Dawn-Eternal orbits in a tidal lock that leaves its habitable band forever kissed by the golden light of its star. Rolling grasslands stretch beneath a sky painted in permanent amber, where crystalline quartz formations catch and scatter the low-angle sun into prismatic fans across the terrain.

The air is warm and sweet with the scent of photosynthetic blooms that never close their petals. A perpetual breeze flows from the frozen dark side toward the scorching dayside, creating a gentle wind that hums through the quartz spires like a world-sized instrument.

Early survey teams discovered the remains of solar observatories along the terminator line, their purpose unclear but their alignment precise to fractions of a degree. No civilization survives to claim them, yet the stones show no weathering, as though time itself has been kind to this place.

Dawn-Eternal represents a rare paradise world with abundant biological resources and mild conditions. Its strategic value is tempered by the mystery of who built the observatories and why they vanished from a world that seems incapable of hostility.
